InterpretTransitionRule: rule type flag, playlist peek and next_event_ are ported. Missing (one item): the return value. SetState(int): index store, segments_[2].chunk_index from the state list, and dispatch are ported. Missing (one item): the transition-table lookup when field_38 is 0 or more (outer 12-byte record, 8-byte entries giving field_90 and the byte at +0x4c); the port transitions_ holds 36-byte records, so the layout is not carried over

IMA DecodeSegment: the loop is transcribed and the stop logic matches. Missing (one item): the UpdateSegmentsStates call (0x885740, partial: the next_event_ loop-list length assumption). No test drives the segment loop

IMA DecodeCurrentSegmentWithOffset: pending-frame zeroing and loop are transcribed. Missing (one item): the UpdateSegmentsStates call (0x885740, partial: the next_event_ loop-list length assumption). No test drives the loop

StreamCFileCursor::Init: owner check, no handle yet, Open with mode 6 on owner fs. Missing: which string word is the file name: the asm passes owner+0x1c (the vox string C-string word) and the port passes path_.c_str() because std::string has no such word

StreamCFile::Init: fs = GetInstance, size reset, Open(mode 6), Seek(0,2), size = Tell, Close are matched. Missing: the same file-name word as 0x888728 (owner+0x1c, the vox string C-string); the port opens path_.c_str()

_FillBuffer: 3D setup, mix buffer, source mixing and 16-bit output are transcribed. Missing (one item): the binary returns a float (the 3D setup helper result), the port returns void. Also the vtable slot +0x60 on each mixed source is not named

FillBufferStereo16: interpolating stereo mix from the scratch copy is transcribed; the ramp hand-off between two blocks is not checked by a test
FillBufferMono16NoInter: the per-channel ramp hand-off (the ARM path after the ramp is set) is transcribed but no test checks it
FillBufferMono16: interpolating mono mix from the scratch copy; the ramp hand-off between two blocks is not checked by a test
